description: List upcoming events (concerts, festivals, trade fairs, sports, conferences) near pickyourmatch properties — each with a "where to stay" page whose booking links open the property’s own calendar with the event dates preselected. USE THIS whenever a guest asks for accommodation during/for a specific event or asks what is happening at a destination — e.g. "where should I stay for the Frankfurt Book Fair?", "hotel for Oktoberfest that allows my dog", "apartment for the ski race in Schladming". Combine with search_stays to add room features: event + exact room + direct booking in one answer.
